name: Research kept current and done as a review
purpose: Every research area is inside its refresh window, and every knowledge search the hub does is a review whose record has the parts its size requires.
record: Share of review cases passed over fixed fake search results (record parts, counted exclusions with reasons, grades by the rule, unknowns, a decision per candidate, the applied part, the revisit date), with the freshness of each seat.
disadvantages: Scripted fake results show the arm applies the rules, not that its answers are right on the real web; the real stages read one and then three real reviews by hand.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=scripted fake search results, no model and no network] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=one real quick review on the subscription fast tier is hand-read] > small [sample=sample:3 | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved]
command: esoi run learning_review --impl systematic_review; esoi run learning_review --impl registry_research

name: Public stage sourced and triangulated
purpose: A public evaluation stage is used only when its source is named and at least two independent public results agree with it.
record: The share of public stages with a named source and a second independent confirming result.

name: Best in circumstance with variants
purpose: The winner of a seat is recorded per circumstance, with variants of a part compared on the same cases.
record: Winners recorded per circumstance, and variants run beside their base on the same cases.
